meta.title: About — Hadramout Research Center
meta.description: The Hadramout Research Center is a scholarly center of Al-Ahgaff University, established in 2013 with financial and administrative independence, working in research, consultancy and training.

header.title: A scholarly center in the service of Hadramout
header.lede: The Hadramout Research Center is a specialized scholarly center of Al-Ahgaff University, working in research and studies, consultancy, arbitration, training and translation.

establishment.body: Established in 2013 as a scholarly center of Al-Ahgaff University with financial and administrative independence, the Center conducts research and studies, provides consultancy, arbitration, training and translation, organizes conferences, seminars and scholarly workshops, and publishes books and peer-reviewed periodicals.

visionMission.vision: Excellence and leadership in research, studies, consultancy and training that achieves sustainable development.
visionMission.mission: To provide the right environment for encouraging intellectual and cultural production and strengthening belonging; to reach the highest levels of scholarly and research competence and to care for Hadramout's cultural and civilizational life; to contribute a renewed culture of knowledge; and to build an effective community partnership in the service of Hadramout and its heritage.
visionMission.purpose: The Center works to illuminate Hadramout's past, present and future through research, counsel and training, and to build community partnerships in service of sustainable development.

university.body: Al-Ahgaff University is a private, charitable university established by Ministerial Decree No. 5 of 1994 — the first university founded in Hadramout Governorate. The Hadramout Research Center is the University's arm for research and community service.

departments.lede: Six departments cover the Center's work.

milestones.lede: Key moments in the Center's journey since its founding, as documented in official Al-Ahgaff University news.

items.text: The Hadramout Research Center is founded as a scholarly center of Al-Ahgaff University, financially and administratively independent.
Memorandum of understanding with Hadhramout University's Center for Human & Social Studies.
Launch of the book "Class and Politics" at a cultural seminar in Mukalla.
Issue 1 of the Al-Ahgaff Journal of Social Sciences is published.
The English Diploma's 12th cohort presents its graduation research.
Second International Scientific Conference: "Hadramis in East Africa: Integration and Preservation of Identity".
Issue 2 of the journal, carrying its E-ISSN 3106-9053.
"AI and Judicial Justice" course with the Hadramout Court of Appeal.
The International Office for Arbitration & Dispute Resolution opens; first International Commercial Arbitration Diploma cohort graduates.

meta.description: Hadramout Research Center services: research and studies, consultancy, arbitration, translation, training, conference organization, and scholarly publishing.

header.title: What we offer organizations and researchers
header.lede: The Hadramout Research Center offers a range of scholarly and professional services to individuals, organizations and institutions.

services.commission: Contact the Center describing what you need; the relevant department coordinates with you.

research.name: Research & studies
research.body: Scientific research and studies on Hadramout’s history, society, economy and law — commissioned by an organization or initiated by the Center — alongside scholarly and cultural seminars.

consultancy.name: Consultancy
consultancy.body: Financial, economic, social and legal consultancy and studies for organizations, plus capacity-building and legal-awareness programs. The technical consultancy department analyses organizations’ technical problems and proposes solutions in data analysis, information-systems management and software development, and trains their staff.

arbitration.name: Arbitration
arbitration.body: Promoting arbitration as a way to settle disputes and an alternative to conventional litigation, carrying out the related legal studies, and preparing qualified arbitrators through the Center’s International Office for Arbitration & Dispute Resolution.
highlights: October 2026: the International Office for Arbitration & Dispute Resolution opened in Mukalla.
First cohort of the International Commercial Arbitration Diploma graduated: 25 participants, 120 training hours, accredited by the Ministry of Technical Education & Vocational Training.

translation.name: Translation & language editing
translation.body: Translating scholarly and research papers with care for scientific terminology, and language and grammar editing of research before publication.

training.name: Training & capacity building
training.body: Professional and technical diplomas and courses through the training department, some in partnership with professional and judicial bodies. See the Training page for programs.
highlights: English Language Diploma: the 12th cohort presented its graduation research (January 2025).
"AI and Judicial Justice" course for members of the judiciary, with the Hadramout Court of Appeal (September 2026).

conferences.name: Conferences & seminars
conferences.body: Organizing and hosting conferences, seminars and scholarly workshops.
highlights: December 2025: Second International Scientific Conference, "Hadramis in East Africa: Integration and Preservation of Identity".

publishing.name: Scholarly publishing
publishing.body: Publishing books and peer-reviewed periodicals — most notably the Al-Ahgaff Journal of Social Sciences.
highlights: Al-Ahgaff Journal of Social Sciences: peer-reviewed, twice a year, E-ISSN 3106-9053 — three issues since September 2024.

journal.body: A peer-reviewed, semi-annual journal published by the Hadramout Research Center at Al-Ahgaff University since September 2024. It publishes original research in the social sciences and humanities, reviewed by specialist scholars in Yemen and abroad.

glance.label: Language
glance.value: Arabic, with title, abstract and keywords in English

glance.label: Publisher
glance.value: Hadramout Research Center — Al-Ahgaff University, Mukalla

journal.submitBody: Send the manuscript with the journal's publication form to the editorial email:
guidelines: Original work, not published or under review elsewhere, with a signed undertaking.
Written in Arabic; title, abstract (100–250 words) and 5–8 keywords in both Arabic and English.
15–30 A4 pages, as an unlocked Word file.
An introduction setting out the problem, significance and aims; a conclusion and references in the journal's citation style.
A short author bio with academic degree, affiliation and email.
Publication fee: YER 40,000 within Yemen; USD 120 from abroad.
journal.guidelinesNote: As published in Issue 1 (September 2024); the full criteria and citation style are in the front matter of that issue.
